purpose: The same document laid between a persistent draft and readable paper; the room is the entire background.

producerReview.observed: Tall warm-white PDF sheet occupies most available height at left. The full room is behind the whole composition rather than a banner. Compact source cover is red and portrait-shaped in the draft reference, and divider has a visible small handle. No body or pointing hand is drawn.
producerReview.remaining: Draft textarea and source cover are larger than needed; source tile should be reduced in component implementation. Generated article author list, text and diagram are synthetic mock content and must never replace or assert the real PDF contents. A still image does not verify draggable panes, interruptions or persistence.

runtimeUse: UI relationship reference only, never a full-screen bitmap, PDF page source or character mother.
